description: Come enjoy an evening of drinks, bites, conversation, and community as we bring together families, advocates, and special guests to talk about what happened when an Alabama Supreme Court decision brought IVF treatment across the state to a sudden halt and what we have learned in the years since.
paid_for_by: Paid for by AshLeigh for Alabama Location PO BOX 170 Shannon, AL 35142 Contact Email: info@ashleighforalabama
title: IVF is on the Ballot: An Evening of Stories Awareness, and Action — AshLeigh for Alabama
